messages:
Maya: Quick sync — cost/latency mapping for token events. Goal is schema_v2 + attribution join by EOD Fri. Owners: analytics (Lina) for event schema, eng-runtime (Sam) for runtime metrics, eng-platform (me) for ingestion + backfill. Any blockers?
Lina: Ack. I opened PR 4123 with draft schema and example event. Highlights: event name token_consumed, fields -> cost_usd, latency_ms, model, request_id, user_tier. Link: https://github.com/redwood/analytics/pull/4123
Kevin: Quick Q: model field cardinality — we have >1500 dynamic model tags from customers. Do we hash or keep raw? hashing loses readability for ad-hoc queries.
Lina: Good point. Proposal: keep model_name raw but add model_hash for efficient joins. We'll limit model_name retention in high-volume tables.
Sam: Eng-runtime can emit kv_cache_hits and batch_size metrics per request but need a small API change to include request_id in the telemetry envelope. I'll open runtime PR (289) today. It will be behind a feature flag.
Olly: Heads up — ingest pipeline will choke if we spike with full model_name strings. We should rate-limit ingest write throughput or sample. I recommend per-hour sampling for unknown models until we backfill.
Maya: Noted. Backfill plan?
Lina: Backfill window: 48h for events, computed via existing partitioned job. I'll add backfill job config to PR 4123.
Maya: Example event payload (schema_v2):
```
{ "event": "token_consumed",
  "request_id": "r_123",
  "timestamp": 1680000000,
  "model": "redwood/llama-3-16b",
  "model_hash": "sha1:abcd1234",
  "tokens": 342,
  "cost_usd": 0.0034,
  "latency_ms": 120,
  "kv_cache_hits": 0,
  "batch_size": 4
}
```
Lina: I'll add cardinality caps and a schema note about model_hash derivation.
Kevin: Also add tag for inference_tier (hosted/dedicated/private) — important for cost allocations.
Sam: Will include request_id in runtime payload and gate by FF. Targeting PR out by EOD Wed.
ingest-bot: started backfill job job_id=bf-2026-05-18 at 1801201800
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for analytics-ingest v2 at 1801203600 :rocket:
Maya: Next steps: Lina to finish PR review by tomorrow, Sam to land runtime PR > feature-flag, Olly to add ingest throttling config, I'll coordinate A/B rollout and run the 48h backfill. Ping me @Maya for any blockers. :thumbsup:
